newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Holyman cuts U.K. ferry expectations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Holyman cuts U.K. ferry expectations.

text.p: Shipping group Holyman Ltd said on Thursday it had reduced expectations for its two-thirds owned British operation, Holyman Sally, after a review of its performance.
Holyman Sally operates high speed and conventional ferry services between Ramsgate, England and Ostende, Belgium, and between Ramsgate and Dunkirk, France.
The Ramsgate-Ostende service commenced on March 1, and the Ramsgate-Dunkirk service on May 15.
"There were some technical and operating difficulties with the fast ferries, and delays in establishing the on shore duty and tax free shops at Ramsgate and Ostende," Holyman said.
The company said the service was now fully operational for the peak season, commencing in July.

"While it is too early to be confident of any forecast results for the full year, with the peak season soon to commence, management has significantly reduced its expectations for Holyman Sally in 1997," the company said.
It said the board would meet again next Tuesday, when it would be able to make a more detailed announcement.
Holyman shares closed 12 cents firmer at A$4.57 on Wednesday.
